issues.json_path: revenue_lines.cila8_avg[0].rate (also key_numbers 'Average 24-hour CILA daily rate' and checklist items 12, 46)
issues.evidence: IDHS CILA Rates Update 06-30-25 lists average topline by house capacity: '8 Bed ... $122,806', 6 Bed $129,935, 4 Bed $140,196, against a 24-hour average of $134,395. $122,806/365 = $336.46/day. $375.11 is a waiver-wide average and is not specific to 8-bed homes.
issues.fix: For the 8-bed average-rate case, use about $336/day ($122,806/yr, the DDD 2025 average for 8-bed homes). Revenue falls by about $1,176 per resident per month, or about $9,400 per month for 8 residents. The modeled net of about $5,304/month (6.1% margin) turns into a loss of roughly $4,000/month. Rebuild the P&L, break-even occupancy and startup cash totals. Label $375.11 as a waiver-wide average only.

Use about $356/day ($129,935/yr) for the 6-bed average case. Revenue falls about $582 per resident per month, or about $3,490 per month for 6 residents. The modeled $4,143/month net (6.4%) shrinks to roughly $650/month (about 1%). Recompute break-even occupancy (83.9%) and the $178,346 startup cash figure.

For 4-bed homes (including the three 4-bed homes in cila12), use about $384/day. This adds about $273 per resident per month, so the 4-bed margin is understated. Re-run the 4-bed and 3x4-bed results. The size-specific averages come from the 2025 update, before the 1/1/2026 DSP wage increase, so confirm against a rate letter or the DDD CILA Estimated Rate Calculator.

issues.evidence: $48.76 is the national BLS mean hourly wage for RNs ($101,420), which is correct for the US. BLS reports that the national mean annual wage for registered nurses is $101,420. CareerOneStop (BLS May 2025) shows the Illinois RN median is $46.15/hr ($95,990/yr), so the figure is not an Illinois wage.
issues.fix: Replace with the Illinois (and, for Chicago metro configurations, Chicago-Naperville-Elgin) OEWS May 2025 RN mean hourly wage. The Illinois mean was not retrieved, so this is unverifiable here. Label the line as the Illinois OEWS figure.
